de-01-c2.text: Paul Dawkins (2022). Paul's Online Math Notes: Differential Equations, Definitions. Lamar University.
de-01-c2.quote: The order of a differential equation is the largest derivative present in the differential equation.
de-01-c2.claim: the order of a differential equation is the highest derivative that appears

de-01-c3.text: Paul Dawkins (2022). Paul's Online Math Notes: Differential Equations, Definitions. Lamar University.
de-01-c3.quote: An Initial Value Problem (or IVP) is a differential equation along with an appropriate number of initial conditions.
de-01-c3.claim: A DE together with initial conditions is called an initial value problem (IVP)
